audience: teams who share an email and chat inbox in Missive

useCases.title: Catch up on the latest conversations
useCases.text: The AI lists conversations in one mailbox view, such as inbox, assigned, team inbox or a shared label, and summarizes the latest threads.

useCases.title: Read a whole conversation
useCases.text: The AI reads the messages of a conversation with full body, plus the internal comments and drafts on it, and sums it up.

useCases.title: Draft or send an email
useCases.text: The AI creates a draft email, in an existing conversation or a new one. It sends only when you ask for it.

useCases.title: Assign, label or close conversations
useCases.text: The AI updates a conversation: assigns users, adds or removes shared labels, closes or reopens it, or moves it to the inbox.

useCases.title: Find contacts and add a new one
useCases.text: The AI lists contacts in a contact book, opens one, and creates a new contact in a book.
